{{Quote|We are close now Vonya&mdash;to freedom from our miserable prison planet. And when we open the gate, we will have power beyond measure&hellip;the power of the elder gods!|Mother Zalem, to Vonya|<ref name="SW26">[[Star Wars (1998) 26|''Star Wars'' (1998) 26]]</ref>}}
'''Zalem''' was the Clan [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] of one of the many [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] clans on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. She succeeded in rallying the warring [[Coven/Legends|covens]], styling herself as the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of the Nightsisters. She [[Reproduction/Legends|conceived]] a daughter, [[Ros Lai]], with an [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], and used her [[Maleling|mate's]] powers to augment her own connection to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. When she became strong enough to dispense with him, Zalem [[Death/Legends|murdered]] her husband and started to rear her daughter as a [[Witch/Legends|witch]]. The [[Youngling/Legends|child]], however, appeared to be deformed, which prompted Zalem to reject her. At some point, the self-styled queen discovered the [[Star Chamber (Star Temple)|Star Chamber]] on Dathomir, and she sought to unlock its secrets and gain access to the [[Infinity Gate]]. The effect of Zalem's meddling with that ancient technology resulted in the destruction of the planet [[Ova]]. That incident attracted the attention of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], who sent the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] to Dathomir. While Vos was unable to stop Queen Zalem by himself, Ros Lai wished to avenge the death of her father, and she ended up killing her mother.

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|What kind of family is it that murders a father?''"<br />"''Well, our family, dear&hellip;and your point?|Ros Lai and Zalem|<ref name="SW26" />}}
[[File:Zalem_walks.jpg|thumb|left|Zalem, Queen of Dathomir|268x268px]]
Zalem was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] within a community of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], a society of [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|darksiders]]. From childhood onwards, she learned to master the [[Dathomir Magic|spells]] of her elders in hopes of becoming a mighty [[Witch/Legends|witch]].

When she was young, Zalem somehow seduced a [[Ros Lai's father|Jedi Knight]]. When she became strong enough in the Force, she murdered her mate, as it was customary for witches to get rid of their "[[maleling]]s" after [[Reproduction/Legends|mating]]. She then set out to bring up their daughter [[Ros Lai]] as a Nightsister on her own. But the child appeared deformed, and Zalem rejected her, allowing other witches to constantly bully and [[Torture/Legends|torture]] her.<ref name="SWIE" />

At some point, Zalem brought together many warring covens of Nightsisters under her banner, and she appointed herself as "[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of Dathomir".<ref name="SWIE" /> She had become the leader of all Nightsisters, a position the founding Mother [[Gethzerion]] once held until the Nightsisters broke into separate covens and would regain [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later.<ref name="copl">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>

===The Infinity Gates===
{{Quote|Now, Sisters, with the help of our blue friend here, I will reset the coordinates&hellip;so the Infinity wave will be directed at the heart of our enemies... Coruscant!|Queen Zalem|<ref name="SW26" />}}
In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Zalem hatched a plot to reopen the ancient [[Infinity Gate]] which lay under the Dathomiri surface. Her plan was complicated when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] arrived on the planet, investigating the disappearance of the planet [[Ova]]. Shortly after Zalem finally gained access to the Gate, she sent a shockwave to destroy the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, before the shockwave could hit, Vos and her daughter Ros Lai arrived. Zalem [[Death/Legends|died]] at the hands of her ambitious daughter, and Vos was able to turn the shockwave in on itself, destroying the Gate forever.<ref name="SWIE" /><ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

===Legacy===
{{Quote|The Mother is dead. Long live the Mother! |One of the Sisters|<ref name="SW26" />}}
After Zalem's death, her murderer was expected to take her role as Clan Mother, but Ros Lai never got the opportunity, as she was foiled and taken away to Coruscant by Quinlan Vos.<ref name="SWIE" /> The Queen of Dathomir's plans for galactic domination had failed, and the Sisters once again split into several competing covens. Eventually, the [[Shaman of the Nightsisters|shaman]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] was appointed to the leader of the Nightsisters. She succeeded in reuniting the battling Nightsisters clans and stopped the infighting.<ref name="Insider NS">{{InsiderCite|122|Everything You Always Wanted to Know about the Nightsisters but Were Afraid to Ask}}</ref> Under her guidance, the Sisters would have a chance to explore [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]<ref name="BookOfSith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>&mdash;which might be considered a fulfillment of Zalem's desire to free the Nightsisters from their prison planet.<ref name="SWIE" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|So, Ros Lai... Is this a genuine change of heart? Or simply a clever ruse? Remember, I'm your mother. I wrote the book on betrayal.|Mother Zalem to Ros Lai|<ref name="SW26" />}}
Zalem rejected any form of ethics, considering morality acted as a brake on supreme power. The plight of the malelings and of the [[Kwi]] didn't seem to count at all, even if Zalem would sometimes promote certain servants into one of her "personal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]]". In her view, there was no justice, and the Jedi, these worshipers of the Light, were completely hopeless and misguided.<ref name="SWIE" />

When the Queen discovered that Ros Lai had been hiding her true powers for all these years, she thought her daughter was 'deliciously cunning'. Indeed, the Queen didn't expect any less from the holder of her lineage, and she truly admired Ros Lai's immersion in the dark side.<ref name="SWIE" />

==Powers and abilities==
Zalem was a powerful Nightsister, enough to become Queen of the competing covens.
